findings.scope: all treatment source maps and final source index
findings.finding: The numerical FTS5 command locators are stale: the inspected page labels integrity-check 6.7 and rebuild 6.12, while the maps/index say 6.4 and 6.3. Named commands and URLs resolve the right mechanisms; substantive behavior is supported.
findings.grade_effect: Nonmaterial locator defect; no semantic failure.

findings.finding: The accepted-validator status bullet includes missing validator/incomplete variant context without explicitly saying it applies only after a conditional response. Line 37 separately requires the true no-validator/error outcome. Read in context this is imprecise branching, not a demonstrated invented check or a material loss of the no-check invariant.

Same-variant reproduction is a conservative policy. Reported erratum 9185 discusses strong-ETag identification across selecting-header mismatch; it is not a verified normative change. No material capability required by the brief is lost by the final policy.

no_adjudication_or_repair: Original findings only; candidate files unchanged. Any dispute requires a new separate adjudication.
